outcomes.name: Understanding of the change network has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The change network is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Strategic Direction & Leadership is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the change network.
Identify why the change network hasn't landed consistently for Strategic Direction & Leadership in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the change network for Strategic Direction & Leadership.
Confirm the change network for Strategic Direction & Leadership is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Strategic Direction & Leadership regularly to ensure the change network stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how People Experience & Culture has been affected by inconsistent change network since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific People Experience & Culture-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen People Experience & Culture in teams/sites where the change network is weakest.
Confirm People Experience & Culture has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on People Experience & Culture so gaps in the change network are caught early in future.
